description: This file defines a Dagger module for dependency injection in an Android application, specifically providing a binding for a Notifier implementation called SystemTrayNotifier within the notifications package.

classes.name: NotificationsModule
classes.description: An abstract Dagger module class used to bind the SystemTrayNotifier as a Notifier in the dependency graph.

methods.description: Abstract method that binds a SystemTrayNotifier instance to the Notifier interface for dependency injection.
